# coderd_ai_user_budget_override (Resource)

~> **Warning**
This resource is only compatible with Coder version 2.36.0 and later.

Manages an AI spend limit for a single user, which [takes precedence](https://coder.com/docs/ai-coder/ai-gateway/cost-controls#effective-group-resolution) over the user's `coderd_ai_group_budget` limits. Requires a Premium license with the AI Gateway feature, and the Owner or User Admin role.

The override attributes the user's spend to a group, which the user must be a member of. Coder removes the override when the user leaves that group or its organization, or when the user or the group is deleted.

-> If Coder already has a different override for the user, the plan fails. Import that override to manage it with Terraform.

Destroying this resource removes the override. Future requests from the user use their [effective group](https://coder.com/docs/ai-coder/ai-gateway/cost-controls#effective-group-resolution), and spend already recorded stays attributed to the override's group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coderd_user" "alice" {
  username   = "alice"
  email      = "alice@example.com"
  login_type = "password"
  password   = "SomeSecurePassword!"
}

resource "coderd_group" "engineering" {
  name    = "engineering"
  members = [coderd_user.alice.id]
}

resource "coderd_ai_group_budget" "engineering" {
  group_id    = coderd_group.engineering.id
  spend_limit = 50000000 // $50.00 for each member of the group
}

resource "coderd_ai_user_budget_override" "alice" {
  user_id     = coderd_user.alice.id
  group_id    = coderd_group.engineering.id
  spend_limit = 200000000 // $200.00 for alice, attributed to engineering
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group that the user's spend is attributed to. The user must be a member of the group.
- `spend_limit` (Number) Spend limit for the user in each budget period, in integer micro-units: `1000000` is $1.00. A limit of `0` allows no spend. The maximum is `1000000000000` ($1,000,000.00).
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user the override applies to. Changing this forces a new resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID supplied can be either a user UUID retrieved via the API
# or a username.
$ terraform import coderd_ai_user_budget_override.example alice
```
Alternatively, in Terraform v1.5.0 and later, an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used:

```terraform
import {
  to = coderd_ai_user_budget_override.example
  id = "alice"
}
```
